channel_id.desc: The encoded `channel_id` to add or remove to workspaces.

org_channel.desc: True if channel has to be converted to an org channel

target_team_ids.desc: A comma-separated list of workspaces to which the channel should be shared. Not required if the channel is being shared org-wide.

team_id.desc: The workspace to which the channel belongs. Omit this argument if the channel is a cross-workspace shared channel.

desc: Set the workspaces in an Enterprise grid org that connect to a public or private channel.
